I'm a project manager who treats delivery as a discipline — translating technical complexity and shifting requirements into structured plans, clear ownership, and shipped outcomes. With over five years spanning project delivery, technical account management, and customer success, I've built a track record of running the project, not just tracking it.

At Ably Soft, I own end-to-end delivery of 400+ high-impact web and mobile projects, maintaining a 98% on-time delivery rate while driving $110K+ in revenue through disciplined scope, risk, and resource management. Before that, at JungleWorks, I led multi-team Agile delivery as a project lead — achieving 100% delivery targets across 5+ parallel teams and a 75% lift in customer satisfaction scores.
